name: Route Typeform leads to Airtable and Slack with SLA follow-up reminders

parameters.content:
## Route Typeform leads to Airtable and Slack with SLA follow-up reminders
Every Typeform submission becomes an Airtable lead, reaches the right owner in Slack within seconds, and is chased automatically if nobody picks it up.

### How it works
1. **Typeform Trigger** receives each submission; answers are mapped by question *ref*.
2. Keyword rules pick the team (Sales, Support, Partnership, General) and flag big sales leads as **HOT**.
3. Earlier submissions from the same email are looked up, so the owner sees returning contacts.
4. The lead is **upserted** in Airtable by Response ID, with its owner and channel.
5. A Block Kit message @-mentions the owner, with a button to the record.
6. Every 15 minutes, leads still **New** after their SLA remind the owner; the second reminder tags a manager.
7. A **built-in error handler** emails you any failure, with a Slack fallback.

### Setup
1. In Typeform, set question refs `full_name`, `email`, `company`, `inquiry_type`, `team_size`, `budget`, `details` (optional hidden field `utm_source`).
2. Create an Airtable table with fields: Response ID, Submitted At, Full Name, Email, Company, Inquiry Type, Team Size, Budget, Details, Routed To, Priority, Status (single select incl. "New"), UTM Source, Owner Slack ID, Slack Channel, Reminders Sent (number).
3. Add **Typeform**, **Airtable**, **Slack** and **Gmail** credentials. Set the form ID and select the base and table in the four Airtable nodes.
4. Edit **Config · Routing Rules** (channels, owner member IDs), **SLA Settings** and **Alert Settings**.
5. Invite the Slack bot to every channel, then activate.

### Customization
Change the keyword rules in **Pick Route & Priority** and the SLA minutes in **SLA Settings**.

## ① Map & route
Answers are matched by question *ref*, so renaming a question never breaks the mapping. Keyword rules pick the team; big sales leads are flagged HOT. A submission without an email escalates instead of creating an empty record.

## ② Returning contact & save
Earlier submissions with the same email are looked up first. The lead is upserted by Response ID with its owner and channel. If Airtable fails, Slack still gets every answer.

## ③ Notify the owner
Block Kit message in the team channel that @-mentions the owner, with priority, history and a button to the record. Slack failures escalate by email.

## ④ SLA follow-up every 15 min
Leads still *New* after their SLA (HOT 30 min, others 4 h) remind the owner; the second reminder also tags a manager. Only reminders that were posted are counted, so failed ones retry next run.

## ⚠️ Built-in error handler
Runs when a production execution fails. Emails an incident report; if Gmail fails too, posts to the Slack ops channel. Leave *Settings → Error workflow* empty.

nodes.name: Typeform Trigger
nodes.notes: Raw payload on purpose (simplify OFF) so answers can be mapped by question ref. n8n registers the webhook with Typeform on activation and checks its signature on every call.

nodes.name: Config · Routing Rules
nodes.notes: EDIT ME. The routing table: one key per team with label, channel and owner_slack_id (Slack profile → ⋮ → Copy member ID). hot_team_size: sales leads at or above this team size are HOT.

assignments.name: submission

nodes.name: Map Typeform Answers
nodes.notes: Contract: submission{response_id, submitted_at, full_name, email, company, inquiry_type, team_size, budget, details, utm_source, unmapped_refs[]}.

assignments.name: route_key
priority

nodes.name: Pick Route & Priority
nodes.notes: Keyword rules on the inquiry_type answer → a key in Config.routing. Team size '11-50' / '200+' uses the largest number.

nodes.name: Has Required Answers?
nodes.notes: Data guard: an expression error or a renamed ref would otherwise create an empty Airtable record with a green execution.

parameters.errorMessage: =[CRITICAL] Typeform submission {{ $json.submission?.response_id || '(no token)' }} has no email after mapping. Check that the question refs match full_name/email/company/inquiry_type/team_size/budget/details. Unmapped refs: {{ ($json.submission?.unmapped_refs ?? []).join(', ') || 'none' }}. Raw answers are in this execution.

nodes.name: Escalate · Unmappable Submission
nodes.notes: CRITICAL: usually a renamed question ref. The raw answers stay in the execution log.

nodes.name: Find Earlier Submissions
nodes.notes: Up to 5 earlier leads with the same email, newest first. Quotes in the email are escaped for the formula. Always Output Data + Continue on error: a missing history never blocks the lead.

nodes.name: Upsert Record in Airtable
nodes.notes: Upsert on 'Response ID' = idempotent. Also stores the owner and channel for the SLA reminders. Execute Once because the history lookup can return several items. Retry 3× / 5 s, then the error output keeps the lead moving to Slack.

nodes.name: Flag Airtable Failure
nodes.notes: Marks the lead as not saved; the Slack message then carries every answer.

assignments.name: fallback_text
blocks

nodes.name: Build Slack Message
nodes.notes: Reached from two mutually exclusive paths (Airtable saved / failed). Text from the form is escaped for Slack mrkdwn (&, <, >), so an answer like "<!channel>" cannot mention everyone.

nodes.name: Notify Owner in Slack
nodes.notes: Blocks must be wrapped as { blocks: [...] }; a bare array posts as plain text. Retry 3× / 5 s, then the error output escalates.

nodes.name: Saved to Airtable?
nodes.notes: Decides whether the run ends cleanly or escalates the Airtable failure.

nodes.name: Done
nodes.notes: Happy path: saved in Airtable and owner notified.

parameters.errorMessage: =[CRITICAL] Typeform response {{ $('Map Typeform Answers').first().json.submission.response_id }} could NOT be saved to Airtable after 3 attempts ({{ $('Build Slack Message').first().json.channel }} was notified with all answers). Add it manually: {{ JSON.stringify($('Map Typeform Answers').first().json.submission).slice(0, 1500) }}

nodes.name: Escalate · Airtable Write Failed
nodes.notes: CRITICAL: the lead is only in Slack. The message includes every answer for manual entry.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ $('Build Slack Message').first().json.airtable_saved ? '[WARNING]' : '[CRITICAL]' }} Slack notification to {{ $('Build Slack Message').first().json.channel }} failed after 3 attempts. Please notify the owner manually. {{ $('Build Slack Message').first().json.fallback_text }}. Airtable saved: {{ $('Build Slack Message').first().json.airtable_saved }}. Submission: {{ JSON.stringify($('Map Typeform Answers').first().json.submission).slice(0, 1500) }}

nodes.name: Escalate · Slack Failed
nodes.notes: WARNING if the lead is safe in Airtable, CRITICAL if it is not.

nodes.name: Every 15 Minutes
nodes.notes: Runs only while the workflow is active.

nodes.name: SLA Settings
nodes.notes: EDIT ME. Reminder 1 fires after the SLA, reminder 2 after twice the SLA and also tags manager_slack_id. fallback_channel is used for leads without a stored channel.

parameters.filterByFormula: ={{ 'AND({Status} = "New", {Reminders Sent} < ' + $json.max_reminders + ', DATETIME_DIFF(NOW(), DATETIME_PARSE({Submitted At}), "minutes") >= IF({Priority} = "HOT", ' + $json.hot_minutes + ', ' + $json.normal_minutes + ') * ({Reminders Sent} + 1))' }}

nodes.name: Find Overdue Leads
nodes.notes: Leads still "New" whose next reminder is due: reminder n fires after n × SLA. No overdue leads → no items → the run ends quietly.

assignments.name: text

nodes.name: Build Reminder
nodes.notes: One reminder per overdue lead. Form text is escaped for Slack mrkdwn.

nodes.name: Send Reminder
nodes.notes: No node-level retry: with several items it would re-post reminders that already went out. A failed reminder is simply picked up again by the next run.

nodes.name: Mark Reminder Sent
nodes.notes: Counts only reminders that were posted. Placed above the failure branch so it runs first.

nodes.name: Escalate · Reminders Not Sent
nodes.notes: Slack error items carry no link to their lead, so the failed ones are derived from what was marked as sent.

nodes.name: On Workflow Error
nodes.notes: Internal error workflow: n8n starts here when any production execution of THIS workflow fails (and Settings → Error workflow is empty).

nodes.name: Alert Settings
nodes.notes: EDIT ME. Who gets incident alerts. Comma-separate multiple emails.

assignments.name: severity
error_message
assignments.value: ={{ String($('On Workflow Error').first().json.execution?.error?.message ?? $('On Workflow Error').first().json.trigger?.error?.message ?? 'No error message provided').slice(0, 2000) }}

nodes.name: Build Incident Report
nodes.notes: Normalises the Error Trigger payload (execution errors and trigger errors have different shapes) into one incident record.

nodes.name: Email Alert
nodes.notes: Primary alert. Email is independent of every service this workflow monitors, so an outage of those services cannot silence the alert. Retries 3× / 5 s, then the fallback runs.

nodes.name: Fallback · Slack Ops Channel
nodes.notes: Only runs when the email alert failed after 3 tries. Reuses this workflow's Slack credential; invite the bot to the ops channel.
